flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3100 then Open the LoopMune store.
Do not add anything to the cart.
In the checkout form enter name 'Kane Check' and email 'kane@example.com' and submit.
The checkout must be REJECTED with an error saying the cart is empty, and no order confirmation may appear.
If an order is confirmed, @v16:"the check fails."
